next.reason: 1985: after the USE procedure, if the status is not 'critical' (3x, 4x, implementor 9x) control returns to the next executable statement after the I-O statement, else the implementor decides. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7: 'control is returned to an implicit CONTINUE statement following the input-output statement whose execution caused the exception' unless a fatal EC-I-O condition (3x, 4x fatal; 9x implementor), when the implementor determines. Same classes, same effect.
